collection.description: At the well, a curious villager asks how a man could have carried a baby.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At the well, a curious villager asks how a man could have carried a baby. The father, (subject), must decide whether he wants to answer; the child is busy trying to grab the water bucket.

choices.label: Change the Subject to the Child

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The questioner thanks him and moves on.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The explanation prompts more questions, and he ends the conversation.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The villager accepts that his private life is private.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The villager looks confused, but does not press further.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They end up discussing the baby's astonishing grip.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The baby splashes water over both of them.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They have a thoughtful conversation about assumptions.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The villager struggles to explain, and they part politely.
